company.name: Wattvision
company.shortDescription: Wattvision helps users save money on energy by providing them with live feedback on their energy use, on the web or mobile phones.
company.description: Wattvision offers a simple idea: Monitor your energy consumption in realtime from the web. To do this you need a Wattvision WiFi Sensor, but if you have a digital power meter at your home, you don't even need an electrician to install this for you.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that collects and visualizes live energy consumption data from various sensors for homes, businesses, and rental properties.
